summary: Tile v2: N=8 int8 systolic core (registered products) + 16/32/32 KiB A/B/C block-RAM buffers + sequencer + Wishbone classic 32-bit slave, generated from Mojo comptime. Bit-exact and cycle-exact vs the Mojo bus-level model over 62 randomized register-level programs; 97 MHz on LFE5U-85F using 41% of DSPs and 8.6% of logic.

checked_each_access: ack timing (request cycle ack=0, next cycle ack=1, idle cycles ack=0)

synthesis.flow: yosys synth_ecp5 (DSP mapping) + nextpnr-ecp5 --freq 200 --timing-allow-fail, bare top (90 I/O, no wrapper)
synthesis.critical_path: register -> combinational MULT18X18D (3.9 ns) -> routing -> prodq register (about 10.3 ns total)

vexriscv_standard_measured.source: pythondata-cpu-vexriscv 642ecfed VexRiscv.v (LiteX 'standard': rv32im, I$/D$), yosys synth_ecp5 only, no P&R

litedram_and_soc_infra_estimate.note: LiteDRAM is not checked out locally; rough estimate, to be replaced by lane-soc's build: SDR SDRAM controller+PHY about 1.5-3k LUT4, ECP5 DDR3 PHY+controller about 3-5k LUT4 and a few EBR; LiteX bus/UART/timer/CSR about 1-2k LUT4; BIOS ROM + SRAM about 10-30 EBR

soc_budget_85f.conclusion: tile2 + VexRiscv + SDRAM controller + LiteX infrastructure is about 15-20k of 83.6k logic cells, about 70/156 DSPs and about 60-80/208 EBR. A second tile2_n8 also fits (128+4 DSPs).

soc_integration.where: fpga/soc (LiteX VexRiscv SoC, Verilator), slave at 0x90000000 uncached, adr[14:0]
soc_integration.reproduce: cd fpga/soc && pixi run soc && pixi run tiletest
